{C:ALEX}{1.04-5.24}Been going well, dad. Few sub appearances. More than I expected. {6.84-9.09}Think you'll be able to come and see me play soon?{C:HAROLD}{9.10-12.69}You have any idea how much flights to England cost these days, Alex?{C:ALEX}{12.70-18.19}Yeah but I'm earning now. Not a fortune, but maybe I could help you out?{C:HAROLD}{18.76-23.84}Look, Alex, things are pretty mad here, better be off, ok? Just don't get too dazzled.{C:ALEX}{23.90-25.03}Wait, wait, Dad, Dad.{C:HAROLD}{25.06-26.10}Bye, son.{C:MICHAEL}{30.47-32.44}Remote. Remote. Remote!{C:JIM}{32.45-34.00}Michael, what do you think you're doing?{C:SUSAN WELLES}{35.07-39.74}...and with such a world class player as Harry joining our squad we're confident we can push on from last season.{C:KAREN WALSTON}{40.70-41.91}How does it feel to have signed?{F}{C:ANGEL DI MARIA}{42.74-55.24}Yes, I think it's a new opportunity in my life…I hope that things work out for me.
I'm prepared to score lots of goals, so…time to get to work and I hope I have a successful time at this new club.{C:MICHAEL}{48.11-50.62}That's what I'm doing here. Signed this morning.{C:ALEX}{50.63-51.90}Another striker?{C:MICHAEL}{52.00-54.17}They reckon the manager's looking to start him up top next game.{C:JIM}{54.16-56.42}They? Who have you been talking to?{C:MICHAEL}{56.84-60.17}So I made a few calls on the way over. Don't get me wrong. It might just be gossip...{C:JIM}{60.20-62.62}Come on. Spit it out, Michael!{C:MICHAEL}{63.06-68.26}They're planning on playing Gareth in behind him. Apparently they think he's a better fit for the system.{C:SUSAN WELLES}{64.45-71.17}We're very happy with the business we've done bringing such a world class player into the squad
in addition to Joaquin Gallo and Philip Bernard,{72.37-78.17}as well as signing several promising youngsters, like Gareth Walker
so we're very happy with the group as it stands now, but in this game you never know.

"{C:CATHERINE}{2.39-4.53}Shift starts in half an hour.{C:JIM}{5.04-6.54}It won't be long now.{C:CATHERINE}{7.67-10.04}Do you think Alex will be OK? {10.92-15.81}He's been talking about his dad a lot recently. I mean maybe the pressure of the exit trials got on top of him.{C:JIM}{16.85-18.61}He played well today.{23.13-27.11}Listen Catherine, about Harold. {27.61-35.15}Maybe if I hadn't been traveling away to games all the time... You know, some seasons it was like ten months of the year.{C:CATHERINE}{35.33-40.23}But you always came back, Jim. You never walked out on your family.{C:JIM}{40.73-46.19}No. I followed my dreams. But Harold's injuries cut his short. It ruined him. {46.81-50.33}Yeah... stopped you from following yours. I mean you gave up everything.{C:CATHERINE}{53.56-55.32}And I'd do it again.{56.82-59.34}You know he just wants to be you.{C:GARETH}{60.72-62.10}Thank you.{C:CATHERINE}{62.36-63.61}All right.{C:GARETH}{62.73-63.74}All right!{C:ALEX}{63.86-66.13}Yeah? What do you think Grandad?{C:JIM}{66.20-70.53}Great performance today, lads. Top drawer. You stood out a mile.{C:CATHERINE}{70.78-72.79}I am so proud of you.{C:MICHAEL}{72.89-74.78}You should be, Mrs. Hunter.{C:MICHAEL}{75.53-77.84}Especially when it runs in the family. {78.02-88.22}""Burly, no nonsense forward. Brave as a lion. Excellent first touch."" Like a sort of yesteryear Didier Drogba. ""22 goals 68/69."" {88.93-90.44}You're Jim Hunter, aren't you?{C:JIM}{90.50-91.55}I know you?{C:MICHAEL}{92.01-94.00}I used to collect football cards.{97.01-101.09}Michael Taylor, Rising Stars football agency. {101.62-108.19}We are absolutely the guys for nurturing young potential, and you boys, you've got it coming out of your ears. {108.63-112.84}You need representation, you call me. Night or day, Christmas Day, doesn't matter.{C:ALEX}{112.90-114.47}Cheers.{C:JIM}{114.50-116.54}We'll keep it in mind.{C:MICHAEL}{117.03-118.60}You go safely now.{C:CATHERINE}{121.50-128.15}I've heard of that guy, was around back when your dad was still playing. We should call him. {C:ALEX}{131.1-133.12}Get in."

{0.90-3.39}{C:ALEX}Yeah, yeah I need to pay my bill.{4.96-10.18}Uh, I've actually never done that before so I'm going to need all the help that I can get.{11.43-16.20}Credit card? Yeah, I have. First one of those too actually. Um…{24.10-29.96}{C:MICHAEL}Jim! Didn’t expect to see you here.{30.31-34.17}{C:JIM}No, well Catherine is working and Alex is a minor, you see. {34.51-38.29}So he needs a guardian here when he discusses contracts, or had that slipped your mind?{38.78-44.37}{C:MICHAEL}Jim, I'm not here to make him sign anything. Just show him. I would never do that…{43.19-47.31}{C:ALEX}Yeah, look, uh I'm going to have to call back later, yeah? Alright, cheers.{48.52-49.77}Phone company.{52.02-57.84}{C:MICHAEL}Let's talk. Don't look so worried. This is good news.{59.38-61.61}Ever seen yourself thirty feet tall, Alex?{62.12-63.12}{C:ALEX}Huh?{63.27-67.31}{C:MICHAEL}I'm talking about billboards. adidas billboards, more specifically.{68.82-70.17}{C:ALEX}Shut up!{70.54-74.48}{C:MICHAEL}I'm serious. adidas wants you in their new UK marketing campaign. {74.98-81.23}Only pick a handful of players from the Premier League and you're one of them. You've crossed over, Alex! The next step. {81.78-85.80}If you're interested, you'll just have to take part in a photo shoot. Day's work, max.{86.36-89.36}{C:ALEX}Photo shoot? I can do that. What do you think, Grandad?{89.46-97.76}{C:JIM}I don't know. They never had anything like this in my day. You say it's just one day's work, right? No more?{98.24-102.60}{C:MICHAEL}Probably less, to be honest. A few hours. They're pretty good at these things. {102.65-104.84}It's in their interest not to waste their talent's time.{105.48-107.02}{C:JIM}Well, I guess it couldn't hurt, eh?{109.18-115.04}{C:MICHAEL}It's a nice little deal, Jim, but there'll be others. It's not about the money. {116.00-122.95}It's about what you want your fans to think about you, your legacy, about who Alex Hunter is. {123.78-133.49}Take your time with this, Alex. Read it over, discuss it with your family and with an eye for the long term. I'll leave you to it.{136.18-141.74}You're a star in the making, Alex. Just be sure it's the star you want to become.{143.84-144.84}{C:JIM}Yeah.

"{C:DANNY}{2.02-10.68}Oh, oh! Check this guy out, mate. What is he doing in the Prem? He plays like my Gran. Should be me.{C:ALEX}{10.70-13.07}It will be, mate.{14.18-17.81}You know, it feels weird not training.{C:DANNY}{17.90-23.98}Take it easy! Take a load off! I mean they'll have you shuttle running and eating salads again before you know it.{C:ALEX}{23.99-25.40}True dat.{26.25-28.00}Can you get that, Mum?{C:CATHERINE}{30.10-34.09}Wouldn't want to tear you away from your important football match.{C:ALEX}{34.16-35.29}Love you.{C:DANNY}{35.00-35.85}Thank you.{C:CATHERINE}{35.86-37.99}Yeah right...{C:MICHAEL}{39.16-42.00}Catherine, how's that new job treating you?{C:CATHERINE}{42.26-46.29}Oh, it's really good. They've got me travelling a lot though. I'm in Barcelona next week.{C:MICHAEL}{46.30-49.16}Ooh I love Spain. Nice one!{50.09-54.84}So what are you two doing sitting around? Shouldn't you be shuttle running or something?{C:DANNY}{54.85-56.50}And what do you care about me for, Michael?{C:MICHAEL}{56.51-61.08}I care about all my clients. Danny, I need to talk to you.{C:DANNY}{61.49-63.15}Ha-ha. ""My clients.""{C:MICHAEL}{63.16-65.76}No, I'm serious. I've been getting calls about you, lad.{C:DANNY}{67.20-72.41}Let's uh let's talk then. After I'm done thrashing our boy here though.{C:ALEX}{72.42-76.61}What? Not happening. So what's up then, Michael?{C:MICHAEL}{76.62-80.24}Actually, Jim called. Said he needed to talk to me.{C:ALEX}{80.25-82.86}Ooh, good luck.{C:MICHAEL}{83.81-87.37}So uh what is it you wanted, Jim?{C:JIM}{88.55-95.68}I uh, here. Here. Here.{96.15-99.24}Get a good price for that online.{C:MICHAEL}{99.47-102.17}You know it was never about the money, Jim.{C:ALEX}{109.68-112.53}Whoa whoa. Hold on.{113.48-115.38}What can I do for you, Mr. Butler?{C:BUTLER}{115.39-118.18}Call me Andy. Eh, just wanted to say well done, lad!{C:ALEX}{118.23-120.13}Eh?{C:BUTLER}{120.14-123.22}You what? Too busy playing video games? Put on the sports news.{C:ALEX}{123.45-126.25}What are you talking about?{C:KAREN}{127.04-133.57}Alex Hunter continues his meteoric rise as his name features on the list of likely players to be named to the England squad.{134.80-140.57}No doubt a day filled with excitement in the Hunter household but what does it mean for England's chances at the next World Cup?{C:ALEX}{136.04-140.07}No way."

Prove your club has the most passionate fans!
Welcome to the world's biggest interactive virtual league.  Every time you earn XP playing FIFA 17 you contribute those points to your club.  A club's success in their league is based on the amount of XP their supporters generate for them on a daily basis.  
Clubs are placed in their appropriate leagues throughout the world, and the clubs with the most passionate FIFA fans will win their tables and earn promotion.  Teams with little support will finish near the bottom and face relegation.  Promotions and relegations will follow real world rules.  
Each season lasts a week.  The tables will constantly be changing each day and you'll need to make sure you contribute as much XP as you can to support your club and keep them from being relegated.
Contributing Points
The XP you earn is automatically contributed to the club you are supporting.  While you are contributing points to your club, so too are the millions of other FIFA 17 players across the globe.  
Scoring
Each day the clubs are ranked in order of their supporter's ‘Average XP Contribution'.  We add up the total amount of XP each club receives from their supporters and divide that by the number of supporters in the club to get the Average XP Contribution per member.  So, if a club receives 1,500,000 XP on Monday and has 1000 supporters they will have an average of 1500 XP.  
At the end of each day teams will be given points based on how they ranked that day.  The points are based on the number of clubs in each league.  So, the last place team gets 1 point, the second to last gets 2 points, third gets 3 points, and so on.  Those points are added up each day and the club that ends up with the most points at the end of the week wins the season.
Selecting Your Club
When you first booted up FIFA 17 you selected your favourite club.  That club is who you are supporting in the all new and exciting Support Your Club feature.  
If you would like to change your club you can do so in the EAS FC Support Your Club panel. The change won't take place until the next Support Your Club season begins on Monday, so you will continue to support your old club until the change takes effect.
You will only be able to change the club you support a limited amount of times.  So, choose carefully. 
Active Clubs
Each club will need to have a minimum number of supporters to activate them in the Support Your Club leagues.  If a club doesn't have enough fans they are still seen in the tables, but are unable to be promoted.  These teams will be indicated in red font and the number of fans needed to become eligible will be shown on the left hand side of the screen.
Rest of World
At any point you can go to a map of the world in the EAS FC hub and select a different league to see how the teams are ranked that week.
There will also be an all-time global leaderboard so you can see the top 99 teams across the globe in FIFA 17.
